up: Retrieve the canonical SMILES, compound ChEMBL ID, compound preferred name, exact activity value, standard relation, and standard units for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614079. Only include activities with exact values (standard_relation = '='). Join the assays table on chembl_id, activities on assay_id, compound_structures on the molecule identifier, and molecule_dictionary. Do not apply any row limits or additional filters.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_value, a.standard_relation, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614079' AND a.standard_relation = '='
